item.stem:
The diagram shows trapezium $ABCD$ with $AB\parallel DC$ and equal non-parallel sides $AD=BC$. Diya studies whether the base angles are equal.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The trapezium has equal base angles because it is labelled $ABCD$.
options.B: Angles at $A$ and $D$ are equal because they sit on leg $AD$.
options.C: Angles at $A$ and $B$ are equal, and angles at $D$ and $C$ are equal.
options.D: Every trapezium has equal base angles.
